featured_reviews.name: Benaisha Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Admitting my 2 boys to Little Hearts Preschool was the best decision for their strong foundation in education. The school environment is extremely welcoming, inclusive, warm and enthusiastic. The entire school staff is wonderful, loving and caring with the children. The teachers take efforts to give individual attention to each child, identify their areas of interest, strong points and work on their areas on improvement. Special thanks to Meher ma’am, Binaifer ma’am, Parveen ma’am, Manju ma’am for all their help and insights …Their approach to teaching is wholesome - a mix of fun filled activities, story telling, songs, field trips to reinforce the traditional methods. In addition to the standard curriculum, it is lovely to see other areas of focus such as sports, various festivals celebration along with understanding their genesis and customs. My boys really blossomed in their 2 years here, thoroughly enjoyed their time here and was a second home to them. I would like to specially mention the fantastic annual days the teachers and students put up… all kids participate and are super excited to be on stage.. kudos to the efforts and patience put in by the teachers .. overall Little Hearts has been amazing experience for us!!!

As much as my kids enjoyed their school, I made sure their field trips we're not missed bcz so much learning happens in little fun ways..
My special thanks to Binaifer miss and Meher mam for the foundation they gave my daughter, and now nurturing little one with utmost care and love. No other school like Little Hearts Pre School ♥️

featured_reviews.review_text: As a parent of a Grade 7 student at Orchids The International School - Palagaly, I am particularly delighted with the Science Department and its approach to middle school science. This approach has significantly boosted my child's analytical skills and made complex topics accessible and fun. I truly commend the Science Department for fostering a love for scientific inquiry.
